statement: Ten mirror generators exist (sync-runtime-mirrors, codex sync-prompts/sync-agents/generate-command-routers, hermes sync-prompts/sync-skills, pi sync-prompts/sync-agents, sync-hook-registrations, sync-gate1-pointers) plus check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs as a content gate; every generator implements --check.

The four hook registration files (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks.json, .devin/hooks.v1.json) are GENERATED from hook-registry.json by sync-hook-registrations.cjs (render the hooks key, keep other keys), and --check runs at pre-commit and in CI.

Three manifest claims are false as written: .codex/SYNC.md:120 'hooks.json and config.toml are hand-authored. No generator produces them'; .devin/SYNC.md:31 'hooks.v1.json hand-authored'; .devin/SYNC.md:126 'hooks.v1.json is hand-authored and unmirrorable'. .devin/SYNC.md also contradicts itself at :46 ('re-run the generator'). A maintainer following :120 would hand-edit a generated file and be contradicted by the pre-commit gate.

Four working --check modes run in neither pre-commit nor CI: pi/sync-agents-pi.cjs, pi/sync-prompts-pi.cjs, hermes/sync-prompts-hermes.cjs, hermes/sync-skills-hermes.cjs — concentrated on the two translation-heavy runtimes. The pre-commit set is also one entry short of CI's (sync-gate1-pointers.cjs --check is CI-only).

Genuinely hand-maintained: .claude/mcp.json and settings.json non-hooks keys and statusline-command.sh; .codex/config.toml and AGENTS.md prose; .cursor/mcp.json and rules/skill-routing.md packet list; .pi/mcp.json, models.json, settings.json, statusline.sh and three pi-*config.json; .devin/config.local.json and mcp_config.json; .hermes holds only .gitkeep.

Drift instance (a): .cursor/SYNC.md:36 documents .cursor/mcp.json as a symlink with a double hop; it is a real file. Three independent copies exist (.claude, .cursor, .devin) and are currently byte-identical (md5 ae5cfafa...), while .pi/mcp.json differs by design (adds transport: stdio, lifecycle: lazy). Nothing would notice the first three diverging.
evidence: shell md5 + diff across four MCP configs

statement: Drift instance (b): .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md names 8 of the 13 top-level skill packets; missing are mcp-code-mode, mcp-tooling, sk-communication, sk-vision and system-skill-advisor. This quantifies the known gap at .cursor/SYNC.md:114 and matters doubly because Devin reads the same rules file.

Cost ranks for the two worthwhile generators: extending sync-gate1-pointers.cjs to render the skill-routing packet list is low (machinery, canonical source, --check and two render targets all exist); a four-dialect MCP config generator is medium (claude/cursor/devin byte-identical today, pi needs a dialect map, pattern already proven by sync-hook-registrations.cjs). A .codex/config.toml generator is high cost and not recommended.
